The type SBD11B is a single phase, high speed, high impedance, static 
differential relay. It was specially designed to provide differential protection 
for high and low voltage AC busses. However, because of its design and 
sensitivity, this relay may also be used for shunt reactor differential 
protection. While the normal bus scheme requires three SBD11B relays one per 
phase the number of relays required for the protection shunt reactor depends on 
the scheme employed.

The first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the 
activities required prior to testing. Some of these steps could be performed 
days before the actual test. The second section Preparation for testing 
describes the steps to set up the equipment for performing the actual tests. The 
third section is the actual test.

The first draft is initiated and tested by Eng. 
Saber Mohamed and Eng.Ragab Abd Elgwad, accepted by Eng. Mahmoud Badawy, 
Electrical Maintenance and Protection Manager, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Moussa 
Executive Operation and Maintenance Manager, revised by quality control head 
sector Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab.

Protections | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The type SBD11B is a single phase, high speed, high impedance, static 
differential relay. It was specially designed to provide differential protection 
for high and low voltage AC busses. However, because of its design and 
sensitivity, this relay may also be used for shunt reactor differential 
protection. While the normal bus scheme requires three SBD11B relays one per 
phase the number of relays required for the protection shunt reactor depends on 
the scheme employed.
The first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the 
activities required prior to testing. Some of these steps could be performed 
days before the actual test. The second section Preparation for testing 
describes the steps to set up the equipment for performing the actual tests. The 
third section is the actual test.
The first draft is initiated and tested by Eng. 
Saber Mohamed and Eng.Ragab Abd Elgwad, accepted by Eng. Mahmoud Badawy, 
Electrical Maintenance and Protection Manager, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Moussa 
Executive Operation and Maintenance Manager, revised by quality control head 
sector Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab.

sections_ar.text: ريلاي SBD11B هو ريلاي تفاضلي ساكن أحادي الوجه، عالي السرعة وعالي المعاوقة. وقد صُمم خصيصًا لتوفير الحماية التفاضلية لقضبان التيار المتردد ذات الجهد العالي والمنخفض. ومع ذلك، وبسبب تصميمه وحساسيته، يمكن أيضًا استخدام هذا الريلاي في الحماية التفاضلية للمفاعل المتوازي. وفي حين أن مخطط القضبان العادي يتطلب ثلاثة ريلايات SBD11B، واحد لكل وجه، فإن عدد الريلايات اللازمة لحماية المفاعل المتوازي يعتمد على المخطط المستخدم.

تصف الخطوات التمهيدية الأولى للتحضير لاختبار الريلاي الأنشطة المطلوبة قبل الاختبار. ويمكن تنفيذ بعض هذه الخطوات قبل أيام من الاختبار الفعلي. ويصف القسم الثاني «التجهيز للاختبار» خطوات تجهيز المعدات لإجراء الاختبارات الفعلية. أما القسم الثالث فهو الاختبار الفعلي.
